Configuration is three files deep-merged, not one file copied

Bundled defaults are the floor. Your shared config covers them, a project config covers that. You write only the keys you need — and a key you never mention keeps working.

null is not the same as deleting a key. Writing null means “skip this check”. Deleting the line brings the layer above back — which is usually not what you meant.
